_note: AI capability areas used by Oroboros. Each area has the queries the nightly ingest runs. Edit queries here, never in code. 'human' has no feed: its momentum is fixed at 1.0.

areas.name: Document processing
areas.blurb: Reading forms, scans, invoices and claims files, and pulling out the fields.
areas.arxiv: abs:"document understanding" OR abs:"optical character recognition" OR abs:"information extraction"

areas.name: Writing and summarising
areas.blurb: Drafting letters, reports and replies, and summarising long text.

areas.name: Agents and tool use
areas.blurb: Software that plans steps, calls tools and runs workflows on its own.
areas.arxiv: abs:"LLM agent" OR abs:"tool use" OR abs:"agentic"

areas.name: Speech and conversation
areas.blurb: Transcribing calls, talking to customers, voice assistants.
areas.arxiv: abs:"speech recognition" OR abs:"text-to-speech" OR abs:"spoken dialogue"

areas.name: Vision
areas.blurb: Looking at photos and video: damage, defects, identity, scenes.
areas.arxiv: abs:"object detection" OR abs:"image classification" OR abs:"vision-language"

areas.name: Translation
areas.blurb: Moving text and speech between languages.

areas.name: Data analysis and forecasting
areas.blurb: Spreadsheets, anomaly and fraud checks, forecasts, dashboards.
areas.arxiv: abs:"time series forecasting" OR abs:"anomaly detection" OR abs:"tabular data"

areas.name: Research and reasoning
areas.blurb: Looking things up, checking rules, weighing evidence, making a call.
areas.arxiv: abs:"retrieval-augmented" OR abs:"question answering" OR (abs:reasoning AND abs:"large language model")

areas.name: Robotics and physical work
areas.blurb: Machines that move, lift, drive and repair in the real world.

areas.name: Human-centred work
areas.blurb: Care, trust, negotiation, coaching and leadership. No feed: momentum fixed at 1.0.
